text: Occupation: Retiree
My name is Johnny Hernandez, and I am proud to be a candidate for Santa Fe Springs City Council.

I was raised in Santa Fe Springs and have proudly called this city home for 65 years. It is where I raised my children, now enjoy my grandchildren, attended local schools, and participated in our city's recreation programs.

My commitment to public service began early on. I served as ASB President at Pioneer High School and later earning my AA at Rio Hondo College and continued my education at California State University, Fullerton.

In 1981, I began my career with the City of Santa Fe Springs, serving our community for 33 years in Recreation and Public Works, retiring in 2015 while continuing to contribute as Planning Commissioner.

My dedication to Santa Fe Springs continues today through volunteer work supporting families in need and fostering children alongside community leaders. I was honored to receive the City's Innovation Award for my services.
I am committed to protecting our city's values, supporting public safety, strengthening our community, and ensuring Santa Fe Springs remains a great place to live, work, and raise a family.
Johnny Hernandez

text: Age: 27
Occupation: MPA

I've had the privilege of living and growing up in the City of Santa Fe Springs my entire life. The strong connection with the city has allowed me to cherish fond memories with my family at city events, build amazing neighborhood friendships, and now take on the opportunity to serve the community to the best of my ability.

I am product of the LLCSD, attending Lakeview and Lake Center, graduated with honors from SFHS, and I went on continuing my education by completing my undergraduate at CSULA and recently my graduate from CSULB. My education has led me to work within the public sector for over 8 years.

Now, my candidacy for City Council has motivated me to advocate for stronger support for our youth, greater investment in our small businesses and developing a streamlined process for them, and expanded access to programs for our older adult population, and to ensure our city develops guidelines to prevent the construction of data centers that would harm the community.
I humbly ask for your vote, providing a voice for all residents and ensuring our city's future remains strong for generations to come.
Thank you and many blessings to everyone.

text: Dearest Residents and Friends,

I come before you as a lifelong resident of Santa Fe Springs. I was born and raised here and blessed to call this city home. I have served for the past 17 years, and I look forward to the opportunity to continue to serve the community.

While there is always work to be done in the future in our city, I am proud to have been a part of many milestones within the city. Most recently the renovation of the Aquatic Center, a new police department, and the great upgrades at our neighborhood center for seniors and families.

I hope to continue this journey to improve our financial management plan. I vow to continue to make public safety a priority with the best fire and police services, I will continue to do my part to support the growth within the community and business partners. I commit to continuing to keep the community and its residents the most important reason for my service to this city. I respectfully ask for your support with a vote on November 3,2026.

text: Occupation: Human Resources Manager
Dear Residents,

I am proud to call Santa Fe Springs home. My husband and I have been residents of this wonderful community for more than 33 years. We raised our children here, and they benefited from the excellent schools, dedicated teachers, and strong sense of community that make Santa Fe Springs such a great place to live.
A special thank you to all Veterans and the brave men and women serving in our Armed Forces. On behalf of all Americans, your service and commitment are deeply appreciated.

In 2018, I was honored to be elected to the Santa Fe Springs City Council. Since then, I have remained committed to listening to the needs and concerns of all residents. I work hard to represent our community with leadership, compassion and integrity.

Every resident matters, and your voice is important to me. I will continue to advocate for: Programs, Services, Services for our disabled, and Quality of Life that make Santa Fe Springs a great place for families, seniors, and future generations.
I respectfully ask for your support and vote on November 3, 2026. God Bless Santa Fe Springs!
Sincerely,

Annette Rodriguez
Mayor Pro-Tem

text: Santa Fe Springs needs leadership with the courage to act, the experience to deliver, and the accountability to put residents first.
I am not a career politician. I am a 20-year resident, working mother, small business owner, and community volunteer who has turned challenges into results.

As President of Metro Little League, I helped save a program that had fallen to 68 players and was at risk of folding. Today, it serves nearly 300 children. Over the last three seasons, we have sponsored 95 families ensuring that financial hardship would never prevent a child from playing.

I serve on the Parks and Recreation Advisory Committee and previously volunteered with the Los Angeles Police Department for two years supporting efforts to combat narcotics and alcohol abuse. Coming from a law-enforcement family, I will stand firmly for public safety.

I will push for action against speeding near our schools and neighborhoods. I will demand transparency and accountability when decisions, including water-rate increases, placing serious burdens on families, seniors, and residents on fixed incomes. I will also support a thorough review of plasma-donation centers, businesses whose operations create excess traffic, loitering, sanitation, or public-safety concerns, and help improve business retention in our community.
It is time for new energy, bold vision, and proven action. I respectfully ask for your vote.
Feel free to contact me at the Odalys@votevalladares.com and visit my website at www.votevalladares.com
